role: cross-market, a long-short FACTOR RETURN rather than a price index
provider: Kenneth R. French data library (Tuck School of Business)
units: daily factor RETURN in PERCENT; 0.55 means 0.55%, i.e. 0.0055. Converted to a decimal once on load and never again.
definition: MOM = average return of the two high-prior-return value-weight portfolios minus the average of the two low-prior-return portfolios, prior return measured from day -250 to -21. A zero-investment long-short portfolio return, NOT a price index and NOT net of any cost.
redistribution: free for research use under the library's terms; kept local with the rest and not redistributed here.
